Pour over guide

手沖咖啡的比例建議一比十六，也就是十五克咖啡粉配二百四十克水，水溫約九十三度，三分鐘內完成。這個比例適合大多數的淺焙與中焙豆子。

Ratio

Use one gram of coffee for every sixteen grams of water and adjust to taste after a few brews with the same beans.

Grind

Medium fine grind gives balanced extraction for most drippers; go coarser if the drawdown is slow and bitter.
